# `aitbc economics propose`

Submit an OpenClaw DAO economic parameter proposal.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc economics propose [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--parameter` | text | — | yes | Economic parameter name |
| `--current` | text | — | yes | Current parameter value |
| `--proposed` | text | — | yes | Proposed parameter value |
| `--unit` | text | — | no | Parameter unit |
| `--proposer-id` | text | `cli-user` | no | Proposer identifier |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc economics propose --parameter <parameter> --current <current> --proposed <proposed>
```
